translation: Qixuan said: This is the Yin Wei vessel; [it runs] five cun above the inner ankle in the division of the calf, ascending in parallel with the Shaoyin meridian. To puncture the Feiyang vessel [one needles] one cun above the inner ankle, in front of Shaoyin, at its confluence with the Yin Wei — this is the Zhubin point. The Jia Yi jing says: The collateral (luo) of Taiyang that separately runs to Shaoyin is named Feiyang.
